vetSays.line: 🛡️ Evelyn, Bao, Leo and Daniyar met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Evelyn, Bao, Leo, Daniyar are hurt.
🛡️ Meera, Bao, Maya, Leo and Daniyar met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Meera, Bao, Maya, Leo, Daniyar are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Daniyar — Craft 2. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Daniyar chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 2.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Liam just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Bao, Liam and Daniyar met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Liam is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Liam just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ines just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Meera just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Bao just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Meera, Bao, Lei, Sam and Leo met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Meera, Bao, Leo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Liam just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Liam strikes the Elder Big Big.
The Elder Big Big falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Big Big!
📺 You brought down Elder Big Big. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Elder Big Big.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lena just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Daniyar — Field 3. Three offers; they took Rain Dancer, letting go of Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (rain_dancer: villager level-up)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nopadol just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
